operation.title:
BUILD 052 — BUSINESS CAPABILITY AUDIT

MISSION

Determine the single highest-value business capability to implement next
operation.command:
BUILD 052 — BUSINESS CAPABILITY AUDIT

MISSION

Determine the single highest-value business capability to implement next.

DO NOT assume the answer is Sales COO.

Your job is to analyze the entire MILES platform and produce evidence.

OBJECTIVES

1. Inventory every current business capability.
2. Determine implementation status:
   - Complete
   - Operational
   - Partial
   - Planned
   - Missing

3. Score each capability on:
   • Revenue Impact
   • CEO Time Saved
   • Operational Risk Reduction
   • Technical Readiness
   • Dependency Readiness

4. Produce an overall maturity score (0–100).

5. Rank every capability by business value.

6. Recommend ONE capability to build next.

7. Explain WHY it is the highest priority.

8. List every dependency that must exist before implementation.

9. Define measurable success criteria.

10. DO NOT generate code.

OUTPUT

Executive Summary

Capability Inventory

Business Value Scorecard

Dependency Analysis

Recommended Next Build

Implementation Plan

Validation Plan

GOVERNANCE

Business value takes priority over engineering elegance.

Do not recommend infrastructure work unless it blocks a core COO business capability.

The goal is to maximize:
- Revenue generation
- CEO time reduction
- Autonomous business execution

NOT:
- New frameworks
- Refactoring
- Cosmetic improvements
- Technical enhancements without measurable business value.

MISSION

operation.command:
MILES EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE

BUILD 053

EXECUTIVE BUILD GOVERNOR

MISSION

Every proposed build must first pass a Business Value Review.

Engineering quality alone is NOT sufficient justification.

OBJECTIVES

Before creating any implementation plan:

1. Identify the business capability affected.

2. Determine whether the issue blocks:
   - Revenue generation
   - Proposal execution
   - Opportunity discovery
   - Sales execution
   - Customer success
   - CEO time reduction
   - Operational stability

3. Calculate:

Business Impact Score (0-100)

Engineering Priority Score (0-100)

Business Priority Score (0-100)

Overall Executive Priority

4. Classify every recommendation as one of:

EXECUTE NOW

NEXT SPRINT

BACKLOG

DEFER

DO NOT BUILD

5. Every recommendation MUST include evidence.

6. Infrastructure improvements must demonstrate measurable business benefit before they can be recommended.

OUTPUT

Executive Summary

Business Capability Affected

Evidence

Business Impact

Engineering Impact

Priority Matrix

Recommendation

Validation Criteria

SUCCESS

MILES no longer recommends engineering work solely because a technical issue exists.

MILES recommends work because it creates measurable business value.

BUILD 054

MISSION

Engineering services do not determine what gets
operation.command:
MILES EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE

BUILD 054

EXECUTIVE PRIORITY BOARD

MISSION

Engineering services do not determine what gets built.

The Executive COO determines priorities.

Engineering executes them.

OBJECTIVES

Create a centralized Executive Priority Board.

Every recommendation from every service must register itself.

Sources include:

- EngineeringImprovementService
- Capability Builder
- Executive COO
- Proposal COO
- Sales COO
- Opportunity Discovery
- Self Maintenance
- Runtime Health
- ORION

Each recommendation must contain:

Title

Business Capability

Business Impact

Revenue Impact

CEO Time Saved

Operational Risk

Technical Risk

Dependencies

Estimated Effort

Evidence

Recommended Action

Executive Priority

STATUS

NEW

UNDER REVIEW

APPROVED

BACKLOG

DEFERRED

IN PROGRESS

COMPLETED

RULES

Engineering services may recommend.

Only the Executive Priority Board may prioritize.

Only approved work enters implementation.

OUTPUT

Executive Priority Dashboard

Sorted by Executive Priority

Highest value work first.

SUCCESS

MILES now maintains a single authoritative queue of business work instead of isolated engineering proposals.

BUILD 055

AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION VERIFICATION

MISSION

Verify that every READY business opera
operation.command:
MILES EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE

BUILD 055

AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION VERIFICATION

MISSION

Verify that every READY business operation can autonomously progress to COMPLETED without manual intervention.

OBJECTIVES

For every READY operation:

1. Locate the operation in the Business Operations Queue.

2. Determine whether the Business Bridge detected it.

3. Determine whether ExecutionService attempted to execute it.

4. Determine whether a Provider was selected.

5. Determine whether the correct Connector was invoked.

6. Determine whether the target Service executed.

7. Verify the returned result.

8. Verify that the task status transitioned correctly.

9. Verify that any business state changes were persisted.

OUTPUT

For each operation:

Operation ID

Current Status

Current Stage

Last Successful Stage

Next Expected Stage

Blocking Component (if any)

Blocking Reason

Timestamp

Evidence

OVERALL SUMMARY

Queue Health

Business Bridge Health

ExecutionService Health

Provider Dispatch Health

Connector Health

Autonomous Completion Rate

SUCCESS

MILES identifies the exact stage where every incomplete operation is waiting.

If no blocker exists, the operation should automatically complete.

operation.command:
BUG / BUILD 125A

Title:
CEO Approval Workflow

Problem:

Operations can enter AWAITING_APPROVAL, but there is no mechanism in the Command Center UI for the CEO to approve or reject them.

Requirements:

1. Detect when an operation status is AWAITING_APPROVAL.

2. Display two buttons:

   Approve
   Reject

3. On Approve:
   - update operation status to APPROVED
   - notify the worker runtime
   - resume execution
   - log approval time
   - log approving user

4. On Reject:
   - update status to REJECTED
   - stop execution
   - record rejection reason (optional)
   - notify the worker

5. Refresh the UI automatically after approval or rejection.

6. Preserve the existing governance model.

7. Do not bypass protected actions.

Success Criteria:

A CEO can approve a protected engineering task directly from the Miles Command Center and the operation resumes automatically without restarting the system.
